reviews.name: Suraya
reviews.ate:
Fatteh 
- warm chickpeas, eggplant, crispy pita & tehina yogurt + almonds, cashews & brown butter

Hummous
- chickpeas seasoned with tehina, lemon & garlic

Rakakat
- crispy fried cheese with garlic chives & a sumac lemon toum

Halabi Kebab
- ground lamb kebabs brushed with muhammara, served with a small hummous, charred onion, tomato & pepper

Sumac Spiced French Fries
reviews.notes:
The outdoor space was phenomenal and hope to sit at the chef's table next time. The table was a little small and had a little trouble fitting all the dishes on one table. We also felt that we were sitting too far from each other. 

The side of charred onion, tomato, and pepper that came with the Halabi Kebab was just okay. It was lacking in flavor + texture and the portion was a little small. Everything else was incredible!

We cannot wait to come back!!
